title: Ghost wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hat' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff4f81'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3fc1ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M26 52 C26 30 40 20 50 20 C60 20 74 30 74 52 L74 82 C74 86 70 88 66 84 C62 80 58 86 53 84 C48 82 44 88 39 84 C35 81 31 86 28 82 C26 79 26 76 26 72 Z' fill='#e6f2ff' stroke='#b8d4f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hat brim band -->
  <rect x='36' y='19' width='28' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff4f81'/>
  <!-- party hat cone -->
  <path d='M40 20 L50 -2 L60 20 Z' fill='url(#hat)' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M44 12 L56 12' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 6 L54 6' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='-1' r='4' fill='#3fc1ff'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='41.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='41.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ffb3cf'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ffb3cf'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 56 Q50 62 55 56' fill='none' stroke='#2b3a67' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
